job_description:
AI Engineer
Lufinity AI · Germany (Remote)

About the job

AI Engineer | AI SaaS Platform - Remote

Our client is building a product where AI features aren't a bolt-on - they're the core. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to own the full lifecycle: from idea through to production.

RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, model comparison - you'll be close to the problems that actually matter, working directly alongside product and engineering.

What you'll be working on

• Designing, building and maintaining AI features end-to-end - from concept to release
• Building and improving RAG systems including document parsing, chunking and retrieval
• Developing agentic systems to handle complex workflows for power users
• Creating infrastructure for evaluation, monitoring and continuous model improvement
• Testing the latest models, methods and tools pragmatically - and shipping what works
• Making fast, clean technical decisions in close collaboration with product and engineering

What they're looking for

• Hands-on experience building software products with LLM integration
• Strong software engineering fundamentals - you think in maintainable systems, not just prototypes
• Solid Python skills and familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem
• A practical understanding of RAG and agentic systems
• High ownership mentality and the ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality
• Practical experience with coding agents

Nice to have

• Experience with C# & React
• B2+ German (beneficial but not a hard requirement)

What's on offer

• €60,000 - €80,000 depending on experience
• Fully remote across Germany
• Deutschland-Ticket subsidy, Wellpass membership, regular team events

The team is lean, the roadmap is ambitious, and the product is genuinely interesting. If it sounds like the right move, apply and I'll share the full details in confidence.
